about: Hand-checked fixes to NYC DOHMH inspection records, applied per CAMIS by `pipeline sources` before the restaurant list is matched (see pipeline/sources.py load_dohmh_overrides). Use one only when DOHMH's own record is wrong (a typo'd address, 0,0 coordinates), never to move a match: 'when' holds what DOHMH says now, so the override stops applying (and `sources` says so) once DOHMH fixes the record; 'set' holds the corrected raw DOHMH fields (building, street, zipcode, latitude, longitude, nta).

overrides.reason: DOHMH lists Rosemary's at 1820 Greenwich Avenue, which does not exist, with 0,0 coordinates and no zipcode or NTA on every inspection since 2022. The restaurant is at 18 Greenwich Avenue (its menu URL on our list names it); the coordinates, zipcode and BBL 1006060004 are NYC Planning's PAD geocode of that address, and its neighbors at 22 and 24 Greenwich Avenue are in MN23 (West Village).

DOHMH's building number '108110' (its '108-110' run together) reads as 108110 West 40 Street, which does not exist, and its coordinates are 0,0. Croton Reservoir Tavern gives its address as 108 West 40th Street, between Sixth Avenue and Broadway (crotonnyc.com); the coordinates (added 2026-09-26, so the landmark pages and the map can place it) are NYC Planning's PAD geocode of that address, BBL 1008150039. Only the building and the coordinates are set: the record has no zipcode or NTA, and adding one would move its neighborhood and so its restaurant id.

DOHMH gives Bill's Bar & Burger Rockefeller Center only the street 'Rockefeller Center' and no coordinates, so it had no map location. Its own location page gives 16 West 51st St; the coordinates are NYC Planning's PAD geocode of that address (BBL 1012660001, geosearch.planninglabs.nyc). Only the coordinates are set: the street, zipcode and NTA stay DOHMH's, so its neighborhood and restaurant id don't move.

DOHMH lists Tavern on the Green at '67th Street and Central Park West' with 0,0 coordinates, so it had no map location. The restaurant stands in Central Park off West 67th Street; the coordinates are Wikipedia's for it (article 'Tavern on the Green', read 2026-09-26). Only the coordinates are set: the record has no zipcode or NTA, and adding one could move its neighborhood and so its restaurant id.
